name: Nomaguchi Kouichi
source:
A university student seeking to get his teaching license. When looking for a place to do his practicum, he was invited to Jougasaki academy. Since the school focuses on training people with P/A, he feels out of place and prefers a more ordinary school. However, as long he obtains his license he'll take his training at the academy seriously.

He is a serious person and has been studying hard his whole life. Because of this, he has no experience with women. He's never been in a relationship with a woman and would like the opportunity to be with one as much as anyone else.

When he first arrives at the school, he finds that the class he is assigned to for practical training is full of so-called dropouts, and he begins to think that he is not up to the task.

His parents died when he was very young because of a crime committed by someone with P/A, he was raised by his maternal aunt.

He has a sense of justice but is sometimes unable to take action. He is earnest, kind and easily moved by emotions.

P/A: Incompetent

Hobbies: Listening to music, watching movies, going out for walks, cooking
Special skill: None
Likes: Nothing in particular
Dislikes: Nothing in particular
